parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the PolarDB instance on which the application depends.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer greater than 0 and not exceeding the maximum value of Integer.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**

parameters.name: PolarFsInstanceDescription
parameters.description: The description of the PolarFS instance.

parameters.name: PolarFsInstanceIds
parameters.description: The list of PolarFS instance IDs, separated by commas (,).

parameters.name: RelativeDbClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the associated PolarDB cluster.
